note: Set A covers the drawing content more faithfully: the D1/D3/D5 scales, the MDF gable (3/4" MDF, finish P3, steel L-bracket attachment), the steel L-bracket, edge strip, and the glass tile's brick layout and full product name are all correctly bound, and it correctly identifies BOREALIS as the project/vehicle name. Set B instead captures the revision history and title block well (team name, sheet I-501, lot number properly bound to the sheet), but it makes several clear misbindings: the 1/4"/ft slope is attributed to a "PT1 substrate," a 3" dimension is read as shower-pan width, the 3/8" porcelain tile is placed in the Laundry Millwork Detail D5 rather than the backsplash detail, and the bathroom-floor finish claim is circular with an invented condition. Set A's errors are milder (lot number bound to "project," white thinset mortar called the backsplash material, and a vague "surface | finish | PT1" claim), while Set B omits the millwork/bracket/edge-strip and scale facts entirely. Overall A has more correct, better-bound claims about the actual details.
